title: How To Know The Truth About You
paragraphs: Everything else is just an opinion. Isn't this wonderful? This means that no one knows the truth about you. This also brings up a point we mentioned previously. Please open to John 8 again, and let's find out why it is important for you to know the truth about yourself, and also to understand that Jesus did not come to this earth to tell you the truth about God. I was under the impression that Jesus came to this earth to tell us about God. But that's why we never discovered ourselves.

But in reality, Jesus came to this planet to tell us the truth about ourselves. Because we are the ones who fell. We are the ones who lost contact with the manufacturer. We were the ones who had no idea what the maker had in mind about us. We are the ones who began to measure our abilities based on creation. We have started to use our environment to determine what we can do, and this is completely wrong. This is what falling means. The word for sin is... oh my God. Help me. Good.

The word sin is not what you might think in most cases. Sin is not swearing, lying, stealing, adultery, drinking, smoking, and all those things you call sin. That is not the sin. It's just the effects. These are just symptoms. In fact, when Jesus came, and when you read Romans chapter 6 or Hebrews chapter 9 when it talks about the work he did, it says that he came to free us not from sins, but from sin. In the singular form. The word comes in the singular form in Greek. Because sin produces sins. What is sin?

Sin is rebellion against the known will or intention of the Maker. I repeat. Sin is rebellion against the known will of God. Therefore, if you do not know what God intended you to be, do, and achieve, if you do not know that, then you are living without that privilege. God calls that a sin. I will show you how to verify that. To live by the truth and not by facts, you must use faith. Let me try again. In order for you to live according to the truth you know within the existing facts, you must possess an element.

What is it? Faith. What is faith? Faith is the ability to see beyond facts, the truth about your life. Yes? Now, get ready. The Bible, the evidence says that everything that is not of faith is rebellion against the will of God, sin. This means that once you discover who you really are, regardless of what people say or do or what surrounds you, you should believe in what you know, not what you see. To do that, you have to live by faith. You know, faith is not just hope or guesswork.

Faith is built on something very solid. It is based on the truth about you that has not yet been revealed, and you are on your way to it. Therefore, faith is real. This is why Paul calls faith "essence". It is not something mysterious or intangible. It's a real thing. It's like someone saying, "Look, I'm going to write this check." Why? I cannot see my bank account, but I know what I have deposited into it. I put the money there. I put it there, and only I can withdraw from this account.

So you are writing the check even though the bank is closed on Sunday. This is faith. Now, this isn't... listen to me carefully. I hope this helps. Therefore, you cannot release what you call a "faith check". Some of you have a strange definition of faith checks. The check of faith means there is nothing there. No, this is not a faith check. The check of faith is that you know it exists, but you cannot see it at this moment.

So you write a check in front of someone who has never seen a bank, but because you know what's in it, you can write it with confidence. I hope this will reduce bounced checks. Say Amen out loud. Amen. Yes, I have seen some strange believers who think that God is a sorcerer. God is not a magician. God gives you the strength to get better so that you can put it in the bank, so that you can write a check with faith in what's in the bank. Clap. This is a check of faith. John, chapter 8, verse 32.

Then you will know the truth. What did he come to tell us? Right. He came to show us the truth. He came to bring knowledge of the truth. He says, "If you knew this truth about everything, what would happen to you?" What's happening to you? It makes you or it sets you free. I want you to make an important note in your diaries. Truth produces freedom. Governments do not produce them. Legislation does not produce them. The Senate, Congress, Parliament, no one can produce freedom. Freedom doesn't come from anyone.

In fact, when a man or woman knows the truth, prison becomes a living room. Oh God, help me. Because truth cannot be restricted, it in itself becomes freedom. So what does Paul do when they imprison him? He begins to sing. Because he knew that according to the truth about him, and what was the truth about him? The truth was: I must preach before the king before I die. Did Jesus tell him that? Can you hear me? I want to show you how powerful the truth is.

Paul says that Jesus said: Paul, you will preach to the Gentiles, you will stand before the King, and you will preach to kings. That was the truth about Paul's life. So when they put him in prison, Paul remembered: I have not yet spoken to the king. So this is not always the case. This is the truth. Hallelujah. That is why you must discover the principle that God has set for your life, because it becomes the source of your freedom. Now, how does this freedom come about?

This means that if people say things to you that do not agree with what you know about yourself, it does not put you in slavery. I feel like cheering alone because you don't want to cheer. In other words, if you know what he says about you and they disagree with him, you are free from their disagreement. That's why when you know the truth, the truth sets you free from people. Amen. Hallelujah. So when people give you nicknames, it's like water on a duck's back. It simply slips off and you continue to "slip".

Just keep going, in your work, fulfilling God’s purpose. So when you know the truth about yourself, frustration is not your friend. You ca n't discourage someone who knows the truth. I hope this helps you. You know, they have all kinds of treatments for depression. And some of you saints need to listen to this tape five times.

Because I have met many depressed Christians, and you are one of them, always depressed by what people have done, what they have said, what they have felt, how they have treated me, how they have looked at me, what they have done, and what they have not done. You are sick. You are suffering from a delusion. You need to reveal the truth about yourself. Depression comes from ignorance of the truth. That's why no pill can cure depression, no psychiatrist, and no psychologist can help you with depression.

I don't care what they studied; they can't help you. You need the truth. Come on, I want interaction. Jesus said, "You will know the psychiatrist." You will know the psychologist. both. You will read about the science of the mind. You will sit in your room and repeat 20 times a positive phrase that you do not believe in. both. He said, “You will know the truth about yourselves and about what God says about you.” The truth about the product made by the manufacturer.

And that truth, once you know it, will suddenly set you free. Even if you don't want to be free. It will set you free because you will lie to everyone around you. You are not free until you can ignore everyone's opinion. The truth makes you free. Now, where does this fact come from? I want to read this last text. Actually, there are two texts I want to read because one of them is a phrase you will finally understand. Where does truth come from? Write this down. The truth comes from the source of everything.

The truth comes from the source of everything. What does that mean? This means that the only element or entity that knows the truth about a thing is the source from which it came. Everything else is just an opinion. Therefore, the product manufacturer is the only one who knows the truth about it. Therefore, you shouldn't even allow people who have used it to be your source of information about it. Now let me try again. This gets a bit deep here.

Do not allow other people's experiences to become your source of information about a product. Because not everyone has had a good experience with it. Let's go. Some people say they don't believe in certain types of television. I don't believe in... I will never buy... I will never buy this type of car again. That's their opinion. They may have put the wrong fuel in the car. Or they didn't know how to operate it. Then they want to judge all of that manufacturer's cars based on their ignorance of the vehicle's fuel.

I hope you will hear me today. One of them says: Well, I've been praying for a long time. I was not cured. Do not measure healing by your neighbor’s healing or by your neighbor’s lack of healing. Don't judge him by that. Deal directly with the manufacturer. Oh, come on, everyone. Listen, if you never get cured, if you know the manufacturer, then getting cured will no longer matter. Don't rely on the experiences of others. Go and get your own experience from the manufacturer. Let him talk to you.

The source of truth is the product manufacturer. In order for God to be able to tell man the truth about Himself, He could not send an angel. Please stay with me for two minutes. He was unable to send Gabriel. He was unable to send Mikael. He was unable to send any of the twenty-four elders. He couldn't send anyone. He had to come himself. Why? Because only the maker knows the whole truth. Let everyone say the whole thing. everyone. Come on, tell the whole truth. everyone.

You know, some people get small pieces of things, but when you get the source, you get the whole thing. Jesus is the Creator, the source of all human creation. The Bible says that all things were made by him. How many are there? All of them. This means in nature, in creation, in humanity, and in every kingdom: the plant kingdom, the animal kingdom, the reptile kingdom, the ocean kingdom—every kingdom is His creation. Therefore, only the manufacturer knows the truth about everything. Let's read what he says.

Verse 36. So if the Son, the Maker, comes and tells you the truth, what happens? You become truly free. Raise your hands, thank God for the Maker. Hallelujah. That is why you should be careful even about what your priest tells you. Because your priest is not the maker. That is why you should be like those believers whom Paul addressed from Berea. When Paul preached, he was a great preacher, but they did not believe Paul. They sat down and said Amen and everything else.

When Paul left the city, they went to their homes, as the Bible says, and picked up their holy books and checked whether what he said was true. Clap your hands, everyone present. Don't just cheer for everything you hear. Most of the theology I grew up with was not the truth. It was true that they taught me those things, but what they taught me was not the truth. This is why there are so many people in the so-called church living in deep bondage.

Because you, the believer, did not verify what the preacher was saying. Compare everything anyone tells you with the manufacturer's manual. If he disagrees, just smile and say, "That's his opinion." Hallelujah. Oh my God, it's time to end. I'm sorry. Let me just give you the verse. You must come back here next Sunday to get the rest of it. Romans 3:4, it is the last verse. Oh my God, this session about truth and principle will last for about two months. I'm telling you, there's a lot to learn here.

In the book of Romans, oh, prepare to shout for joy now. Romans, Chapter 3, Verse: I do n't know if you can bear this. Verse four. Romans 3:4. Say nothing if you are reading it now. I guess you can't stop, but you can cheer if you want. What does verse 4 of chapter 3 of Romans say? Stop at this point. That's enough time for cheering. She said, "May God grant patience, truly." from? So that God may be truthful, and what then? Every human being is a liar. Clap your hands, people. Make a little noise for me.

Come on, thank God for this morning. What does God want? And every person, this means if someone gives you an opinion about you or your situation, don't believe them. First, check with the manufacturer. Imagine that for all these years you believed your math teacher. That's why I quit mathematics. Your science teacher told you, "Well, you don't have a scientific mind, so you'd better become an artist." And I believed that.

That dream you had of becoming a doctor has faded away because someone lied to you about who you are and what you cannot do. I hope that today you will be freed through the truth. By the time we finish this series, a transformation will have occurred. I guarantee this to you in the world. Because I will begin in October to return to the Bible. It has already begun. We will read the entire Bible and extract all of God's principles. In other words, the truth about everything. And we apply it to life again.

So that those who were zeros, as one of them said, may realize that they are two thousand or two hundred and fifty trapped under someone’s opinion that you are zero. Let God be true, and every other seller a liar. Stand on your feet. Let us pray. Clap your hands while standing. Praise God. Hallelujah.

Well, for those of you watching this program on TV and TBN, and in Guyana and other countries that receive this program and South Africa, I want you to know that this message is not new, but it was hidden because of the opinions of others. I pray today that even as we pray here in this hall, you will stop believing people in your lives and start believing your Maker. Go back to the source and discover the truth about yourselves. Amen. Let us hold each other's hands and pray.

Now remember that the person you are touching is real, so it is best to handle him with extreme caution because you may work with his company in the future. Didn't you understand that? I mean, you don't know who you're touching. You might go to their school, and send your children to the school they will build 10 years from now. You don't know. You will go to their law office and deal with them because they will be your lawyer, so it is best to be nice to them now. Hallelujah.

You are holding the hand of truth on its way to truth. Amen. I'll say it again, you are holding the hands of a truth on its way to knowing the truth about itself. Don't let anyone underestimate your youth because you haven't finished growing yet. Don't let anyone limit you by saying that this is the furthest you'll go in your company, because they don't know who they're working with. Do n't stop where others give you a reward, because there is someone who has a reward for you.

Thank them for the awards, but keep moving towards your own reward. Amen. Humans can only give awards, but the Maker gives rewards. Father, we pray for everyone in this room. You know exactly what they needed to hear. We heard your voice. I pray now for every man and woman, regardless of their age, to connect with the essence of your purpose for their lives. Oh God, make us uncomfortable with how others measure us. It makes us feel uncomfortable with people's opinions of us.

It made us feel uncomfortable about what we were already doing, because there was so much more. Thank you, God. Thank you, great maker. Thank you, Creator of all mankind, for opening our eyes today. We raise our praises to You. Bless these words in our hearts. And as we listen to it again and again, to wash away the brainwashing we have been subjected to in the past, to bring back to us the cleansing of water by the word, and to tell us the truth in the name of Jesus.

Bless those who watch this program, the millions who cry out in search of the truth about themselves. Lord, reveal to them now, as they watch this program, who they truly are in You. Cancel the opinions of their fathers, mothers, and adoptive fathers. Cancel the opinions of their teachers, bosses, and those they work for. Cancel the opinion of society and those who are biased against them, the racists, and all these derogatory things. O Father, may that liberation come today.

Lord, remove those things from their lives, and let the truth reach them. To reach you now. I hope you know what he knows about you. Because you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free. Raise your hands and thank God wherever you are now. Thank you, Jesus. Amen. Thank you again for listening to this message, and we hope it has been a blessing to you. Our goal is to show you new paths and opportunities so that you can discover your purpose.
